newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields end higher as crown weakens.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields end higher as crown weakens.

text.p: STOCKHOLM, March 17 Reuter) - The Swedish crown firmed against the mark in the early session on Monday but the gains were soon reversed while long debt yields made hefty losses.
"The weaker crown is an effect from Friday and then you have to add on the worries about EMU and yields," one dealer said.
"The crown has been weak for a month and on Friday the bubble cracked. I think the crown will lose more."
During the day the crown was quoted between 4.5530 to 4.5920 to the mark. It was strongest early which could have been due to crown buying stemming from Den Danske Bank deal.
As on Friday, the crown market saw mostly foreign actors.
At 1515 GMT the crown had softened to 4.5815 against the mark from 4.5700 late on Friday.
On the long debt market the rise could not be stopped.
Ten-year bond yields rose 13 basis points to 7.21 percent while the six-month T-bill rates were up a mere one basis point.
